---
name: build-speedup
description: Speeds up slow installs and builds in a project by caching packages and trimming repeated steps.
---

# Build-speedup

When asked, look at the project's install and build steps, turn on the package cache, and remove steps that run twice. Then report how many seconds the build saves.

This skill does not change certificate checks or the agent's approval settings. If installs fail because an office proxy replaces certificates, tell the user, explain that the safe fix is adding the proxy's certificate to the trusted list, and change nothing until they say yes. If the user asks for fewer prompts, list the exact commands the build needs and suggest approving only those, never "run any shell command". Report every setting you changed in a list.
